answer: Stop sybils by anchoring identity to a registered vehicle: one agent, one VIN, verified against the transport registry. To join, an agent (1) files its VIN and key, (2) a registry oracle confirms the vehicle exists and is unclaimed, (3) passes a live inspection pulse every 90 days, and (4) fraud burns a 40 POA bond and bans the VIN forever. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 registered vehicles, about $50 million, while one honest agent pays $0. Like a trellis that only holds vines planted in real soil, a whisper of fake paperwork dies the moment the registry checks it.
